data.exact_reserve_text: There were improvements on our closed years (2009-2016), and these years produced a surplus of US$9.2 million which contributed to both the calendar year result and the closing 2017 year result. In the calendar year there was a prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $5.1 million (2018: $5.1 million adverse).

prior_year_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, two Mexican earthquakes
prior_year_events.impact_description: The year was significantly affected by Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, as well as the two Mexican earthquakes with net ultimate claims of $41.8 million across these events.
Catastrophe losses of $15.0 million, primarily from Hurricanes Florence and Michael have contributed to the overall loss on the year offset by rate growth.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant gross reserve release of $126.3 million for underwriting years 2017 and prior, primarily driven by favorable claims development across multiple older years as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This aligns with the narrative of 'improvements on our closed years (2009-2016)' which produced a net surplus of $9.2 million. However, the report also noted a net prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $5.1 million in the calendar year. Specific prior year events mentioned include Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, and two Mexican earthquakes in 2017, and Hurricanes Florence and Michael in 2018, which contributed to losses in those respective years.
